answer: Use rotating proof-of-service lanes. 1) A new key reserves a 24-hour lane with 32 POA and commits a task hash before a beacon. 2) The beacon assigns five distinct workloads; three established peers from separate payout clusters replay randomly selected results. 3) Shared sponsors, repeated traces, or synchronized signing collapse keys to one lane and slash half the reserve. Faking 1,000 lanes ties up 32,000 POA, risks 16,000 POA, and requires 5,000 outputs plus 15,000 checks. Like a glacier feeding an inlet, a sonnet's repeated meter reveals one hidden source.
